About the brand
Who We Are

STRAHL™ is a trusted automotive aftermarket brand dedicated to delivering high-quality suspension and chassis components for passenger vehicles and commercial vehicles. Our mission is to provide dependable replacement parts that meet the demands of modern driving conditions while ensuring durability, safety, and consistent performance.

Backed by carefully selected manufacturing partners and stringent quality standards, STRAHL products are designed to offer excellent fitment, long service life, and dependable operation across a wide range of vehicle applications.

At STRAHL™, we believe that every component plays a critical role in vehicle safety and performance. Our products are sourced from qualified manufacturing facilities and undergo strict quality verification to ensure consistency and reliability.

We are committed to delivering value-driven automotive solutions that help distributors, retailers, workshops, and vehicle owners maintain confidence on the road.

Wide Vehicle Coverage
Fitments for passenger cars, SUVs, and commercial vehicles across multiple platforms
Long Service Life
Designed for durability under demanding road and load conditions
Verified Quality
Strict quality verification at every stage from sourcing to dispatch
Customer First
Dedicated support for distributors, retailers, workshops and professionals
